name: Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewContext
summary: A PreviewContext provides options to configure the iOS 9 3D-Touch "Peek and Pop" feature.
description:
The PreviewContext is created by the [Titanium.UI.iOS.createPreviewContext](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#createPreviewContext) method. You must set
the `pop` and `preview` properties when creating a `PreviewContext` object.

Use this class to configure the previewing context which is displayed while "peeking" a view.

Note: This feature requires iOS 9 and a 3D-Touch capable device (such as iPhone 6S or iPhone 6S Plus).
You cannot test 3D touch on the iOS simulator.
To check if the current device supports 3D touch, use the [Titanium.UI.iOS.forceTouchSupported](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#forceTouchSupported)
property and consider using the `longpress` event to provide a fallback to your users on
non-3D-touch devices.

See also:

* [iOS Developer Library: Adopting 3D Touch on iPhone](https://developer.apple.com/library/content/documentation/UserExperience/Conceptual/Adopting3DTouchOniPhone/3DTouchAPIs.html)

properties.name: actions
properties.summary: The preview actions and preview action groups.
properties.description:
Provides an array with elements of the type [Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewAction](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewAction)
and [Ti.UI.iOS.PreviewActionGroup](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.PreviewActionGroup). Both can be used together.

properties.name: contentHeight
properties.description: Specified the height of the preview which will be shown during "peeking".
properties.default: The available height of the screen.

properties.name: preview
properties.description:
Provides the preview for "peeking". This view is independent from the window which can be openend after
"popping" the preview to give you the ability to provide different layouts for the preview and the full
window. If you want to adjust the preview inside the `peek` event, change the view assigned to this property.

events.name: peek
events.summary: Fired when the user peeks the preview. You can configure the preview
events.description:
You can configure the preview in this event before it is displayed. If the preview context is assigned to a 
normal view like a [Titanium.UI.Button](api:Titanium.UI.Button) the `preview` property can be received here to change the content of it 
before displaying. If the preview context is assigned to a [Titanium.UI.ListView](api:Titanium.UI.ListView), you can also receive the 
properties `sectionIndex`, `itemIndex` and `itemId` here to access item-specific data to display. 

Note: Don't do asynchronous operations like HTTP requests here, since the preview will not wait for the 
operations to complete.

properties.name: sectionIndex
properties.summary:
The section index of the ListView to identify the selected section. 
Note: This property is only available if the preview context is assigned to a [Titanium.UI.ListView](api:Titanium.UI.ListView).

properties.name: itemIndex
properties.summary:
The item index of the ListView to identify the selected item. 
Note: This property is only available if the preview context is assigned to a [Titanium.UI.ListView](api:Titanium.UI.ListView).

properties.name: itemId
properties.summary: The item ID bound to the list item that generated the event.

events.name: pop
events.summary: Fired when the user pop the preview. You will most likely open a fullscreen window here.
events.description:
You can open a window here or update your current UI. If the preview context is assigned to a 
normal view like a [Titanium.UI.Button](api:Titanium.UI.Button) the `preview` property can be received here to change the content of it 
before displaying. If the preview context is assigned to a [Titanium.UI.ListView](api:Titanium.UI.ListView), you can also receive the 
properties `sectionIndex`, `itemIndex` and `itemId` here to access item-specific data to display. 

Note: Don't do asynchronous operations like HTTP requests here, since the preview will not wait for the 
operations to complete.

properties.name: sectionIndex
properties.summary:
The section index of the ListView to identify the selected section. 
Note: This property is only available if the preview context is assigned to a [Titanium.UI.ListView](api:Titanium.UI.ListView).

properties.name: itemIndex
properties.summary:
The item index of the ListView to identify the selected item. 
Note: This property is only available if the preview context is assigned to a [Titanium.UI.ListView](api:Titanium.UI.ListView).

properties.name: itemId
properties.summary: The item ID bound to the list item that generated the event.
